_note: The model should call web_search (perhaps twice) instead of answering. The tool definitions are SandSeek's own.

messages.content: You are a careful web researcher. Use the tools to find sources before you answer.
What is the current federal subsidy for heat pumps in Germany? Search the web first.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs and snippets. Takes one query per call: call it several times with different queries, also several times in one turn.

query.description: Short keywords, like a search engine query.

function.name: open_page
function.description: Read a web page as plain text. Long pages come in parts; pass the next offset from an earlier result to keep reading.

url.description: An http or https URL, usually from web_search.

offset.description: Character offset to start from. Omit for the start.
